studyMetadata.title: Webcam eye-tracker pilot
studyMetadata.description: Records the webcam video while showing 15 calibration and 16 held-out check dots, with a timestamped dot and frame log, so every tracker (RealEye Light, WebEyeTrack, EyeGesturesLite, offline models) can be run and refitted on the same frames afterwards. No tracker runs live. Invited participants only.
